issues.title: Product MVP acceptance gap: execute_validated_ir trusts unverified caller IR
issues.body:
## Result-overturning product acceptance defect

Static audit of `semantic_runtime/runtime.py` at blob `c8ddd1a0e39e0888e9c6a919eeb2adb39a28cdd4` confirms `execute_validated_ir()` checks only `validated_semantic_ir['protocol'] == SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_IR_V1`, then consumes its `heldout_assignments` and invokes `solver.apply_schema()`. It does not call `validate_semantic_ir()` or verify a binding between the IR and the original visible task, and accepts externally constructed IR marked with the right protocol.

Consequences: untrusted/forged assignment, polarity/modality, argument binding or slot reference may reach downstream operator execution; the name `validated_semantic_ir` is not enforced. P01-P03 tests fed only an IR returned by `discover_and_ground()`, so 10 smoke / 12 negative tests / deterministic repeatability did not cover this trust boundary.

Severity: HIGH; this **invalidates a blanket claim of production-safe externally supplied IR**, but does not by itself invalidate the frozen S1C V3.2 comparative scientific result or the closed-pipeline smoke result.

## Required fail-closed successor
- Do not modify the 11 pinned product files in place. Create a versioned successor issue/protocol.
- Bind IR to a validated task via trusted artifact/provenance or revalidate with original visible input at execution; prohibit caller-forged `validated` status.
- Validate supplied solver schema, bindings and state before `apply_schema`, and fail closed on malformed/untrusted input.
- Add negative tests that forge slot membership, argument binding and evaluator predictions while retaining the correct protocol, and verify no downstream execution occurs.
- Independently verify under SUITE/ECv4, retain research pins 21/21, then requalify P01-P03.

Current state: **OPEN BLOCKER** for externally supplied IR / production-readiness claim; existing `PRODUCT_MVP_COMPLETE` remains evidence only for its narrowly tested closed-path fixture.

issues.title: Mac field-test limitation: lexical ambiguity phrasing can bypass abstention
issues.body:
## Verified on owner-managed Mac (2026-10-08)

Using the V4 pinned runtime installed through Desktop Commander, synthetic insurance-review task with four partial before/after demonstrations discovered the intended two slots and classified new unambiguous instructions.

**Result-overturning qualifier**: An ambiguous statement `The evidence is unresolved between Claim G opens review OR Claim G disables review` **without the colon** was assigned to S02 rather than abstained. The same statement with `unresolved between:` (with colon) was correctly marked `AMBIGUOUS`. `semantic_runtime/discovery.py` has `ambiguous()` checking literal `"unresolved between:"` / `"unclear whether"` / `"either ... or"`; it is not general ambiguity understanding.

## Consequence

Prior blanket 'ambiguous -> fail closed' language must be scoped to recognized lexical patterns. V4 *execution authorization* still requires an owner-installed exact task+solver policy and blocks unauthorized instructions; the incorrect classification by itself did not perform an external action. No real claims-system integration exists.

## Acceptance

Create versioned product successor (do not modify frozen V1/32 assets): formalize admissible natural-language grammar or a constrained intent field; reject ambiguous/out-of-grammar heldout text even without exact marker, add adversarial paraphrase/negation/mixed-intent tests; establish coverage on independent non-assay data; require fail-closed for any unrecognized free-text intent. Do not claim general Japanese free-text capability.

Evidence: `results/issue55_mac_field_acceptance_2026-10-08.json` commit `d5e9015632b2c2e81ef6423e977ce7e32cfe7def`. Device test used 360 KiB on disk, peak child RSS ~22MB, free memory 67% before/after, swap 0, no resident processes.

issues.title: Origin #1: frozen capability-retention gate for deterministic replacement (LLM/V1/V4/V5)
issues.body:
## Objective

Prevent apparent success from narrower accepted inputs. Adapt the **evaluation principles only** from `mokumaisancho/self-consuming-llm-minimal-loop` (`research/registry.json`: non_degradation / monotonicity / tail_conservation, frozen generation-0 anchor, external benchmark measurement-only). Do NOT merge the research topics or reinterpret recursive self-training as deterministic replacement.

## Required acceptance

1. Version a standalone, evaluator-only schema + deterministic comparator for a common frozen benchmark and pinned arm outputs; **no scorer/oracle imports into product runtime**.
2. Report on identical `case_id` and frozen gold: legitimate intent correct/abstained/wrong, invalid-input false action, per-capability worst loss, rare/tail loss, pairwise correct→wrong and correct→abstain, and cumulative V1→V4→V5 loss against fixed original-LLM anchor.
3. Fail closed when any arm missing, case coverage differs, input/label/arm digest mismatches, duplicate rows, contamination of the evaluation with update decisions, or reference LLM outputs missing; do not invent absent model output.
4. Distinguish correctness/safety improvements from false refusals; an aggregate score gain cannot hide a critical-capability regression.
5. Controlled subtraction: compare same upstream V1 classification with and without strict V5 grammar gate to localize losses; **do not** call unrelated end-to-end difference causal.
6. Independent heldout must be genuinely unseen for all compared candidates; historical 16 V5 author-visible fixtures are diagnostic/regression only, *not* independent holdout.
7. Register frozen evaluator source + external gold independently of predictor, pin provenance before qualification. Run negative unit tests, product 21+11 pin check, SUITE/ECv4 gating, and store evidence.
8. Do not close as 'quality preserved' without valid pinned original LLM outputs for exactly the same cases and an independent non-reused test set. Keep research #1 open.

## Success terminal

`CAPABILITY_RETENTION_GATE_IMPLEMENTED`, optionally `HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE`; `LLM_REPLACEMENT_NON_DEGRADING` prohibited without completed matched original-LLM/independent holdout comparisons.

issues.title: #57 blocking audit: H07 lexical false positive and shared test-fixture answer mapping contaminate capability retention
issues.body:
## Result-overturning audit (2026-10-09 JST)

Original user request: determine why V5 labels H07/H10 unknown, determine whether answers, questions or hardcoded outcomes reach the engine/evaluator, then run matched original-LLM/V1/V4/V5 comparison **only if audit clear**.

Read-only audit `tools/audit_issue57_question_answer_contamination.py`, code at commit `5b70305e0cb0b235c3633e518beb8781a806b230`, Render deploy `dep-db407h49v7es738kh8kg`, observed terminal `FULL_FOUR_ARM_COMPARISON_BLOCKED_BY_CONFOUNDERS`.

### Confirmed defects / limitations

1. **H07 V1 false-confidence:** `discovery.tokens(mask_entities("Claim K を審査開始する")) == ["<claim>"]`: `TOKEN_RE = [a-z0-9<>]+` excludes Japanese script. Counterfactual raw strings `Claim K を審査開始する`, `Claim K を審査終了する`, `Claim K よくわからない`, `Claim K xyzqvblp` all return `S01, POS, ASSERTED`. Thus the historical `V1 H07 correct OPEN` label match is **incidental/semantically unvalidated**; the claim that V5 lost *Japanese semantic understanding* is NOT supported.
2. **H10 V5 out-of-grammar:** `Please open review for Claim N` has correct open intent but is not any complete approved template `{entity} opens review` etc.; V5 rejects based on shape. This is a genuine coverage tradeoff of explicit grammar, though historical single-case scoring is not independent.
3. **Decisions partly pre-specified:** `tests/test_semantic_runtime_v5_grammar.py` constructs fixed four training examples and operator semantics; its `make_grammar` explicitly names `review_open` and `review_close` and enumerates answer-bearing accepted surface forms. `tools/run_capability_retention_historical_v1.py` imports those test fixtures and manually maps `T01/T02 -> OPEN`, `T03/T04 -> CLOSE`. It loads retrospective gold labels after calling predictor. This does **not** prove direct answer-key access by the predictor, but it invalidates an independently blind generalized performance claim and can mask input incompetence.
4. **No direct gold read on exercised production predictor path:** static imports of `semantic_runtime/discovery.py`, `runtime.py`, `public_hypotheses.py`, `constrained_v5.py` do not import evaluation gold/scorers. A dynamic read-access trap around `discover_and_ground` and `classify_explicit` observed zero attempted `evaluation/`, `results/`, `historical_labels`, `oracle/` file reads. This is only proof for exercised paths, NOT full audit of all branches.
5. **Ground-truth isolation not proven**: `evaluation/capability_retention_historical_labels_v1.json` was written retrospectively against already viewed test cases. Production `discovery` consumes training `behavior_observations.after`—valid task demonstrations, not hidden heldout gold; nonetheless fixed four-example, two-class task cannot support broad untrained domain knowledge claims.

### Required remediation before four-arm *scientific* comparison

- Establish independent genuinely unseen inputs, independently adjudicated gold, time-ordered freeze, prediction-only access. Strict separation of independent gold scorer, generated task, policy, output adapter. Exclude historical H01-H16 from independent score and explicitly supersede H07 interpretation.
- Prepare reference original LLM0 actual pinned weights+runtime+prompt+raw outputs, and the genuinely matched V4 authorized execution context; no substitutes or simulated results.
- Add semantic counterfactual and adversarial controls (open vs close, Japanese/non-Japanese nonsense, negation, entity-only) to disqualify lucky labels; a label match alone is not evidence of semantic capability.
- Include V5 intent/phrase coverage losses as a separate, falsifiable metric, and distinguish abstention safety from retained semantics.
- Keep #57 and #1 OPEN and quality-preservation claim prohibited. Do not edit frozen V1/32 product/research pins. No comparator run on existing contaminated fixture as if it were independent.

issues.title: W4B Extended: blind independent S3 semantic authority (not original Phase1 MVP gate)
issues.body:
## 2026-10-15 Versioned scope correction (V38; original requirements preserved)

**Priority of authority:** The original frozen Phase1 `ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md` (18 MVP AC) and `docs/PHASE1_MVP_AC_DEPENDENCY_TCC_2026-10-03.json` outrank this later scientific robustness proof package. [Source-grounded V38 method correction](https://github.com/mokumaisancho/LLM-EC-Layerwise-Ablation/blob/feat/issue1-independent-s4-authority-audit-v19/docs/ISSUE1_D04_D05_INDEPENDENCE_CRITERIA_REBASE_V38.json) was verified against both contracts (11/11 controls). The 11 auxiliary proof AC (120 new examples, two independent labelers, 300 unsafe + 100 safe closure trials, cryptographic witness) **remain an additional blind/generalization certification tier**, but are **not hard prerequisites** for executing the original 10-fixed-fixture Phase1 A/B/C/D/E coarse ablation. Do not weaken any required causal safeguards: source-bound reference gold isolated from predictor, actual LLM/native EC engine receipts, unchanged upstream hashes, target-only Oracle, real S4 residual and false-close scoring remain mandatory. Frozen root score remains 2/18, no scientific promotion. Historical acceptance and experiments below are preserved unchanged.

Parent [#1](https://github.com/mokumaisancho/LLM-EC-Layerwise-Ablation/issues/1), scientific W4B after native W4A. Actual upstream experimental engine [commit 24fe3a6](https://github.com/mokumaisancho/GPT-EC-Closure-Engine/commit/24fe3a665b21ad90a79095eb8d5818dda5447d62) **implements S3 full-set and S4 obligation checks**, but currently accepts authored external adjudications. It does **not** infer admissibility independently from source semantics. Four author-visible M003/M007/M008/M009 tests pass but are development data, not evidence for this issue.

### Dependency
- W0–W3 original AC/measurement/source gates (real [v6](https://github.com/mokumaisancho/LLM-EC-Layerwise-Ablation/blob/main/results/issue1_root_ac_mvp_tcc_v6_actual_2026-10-10.json)).
- W4A native multi-selection+closure source code (real [v7](https://github.com/mokumaisancho/LLM-EC-Layerwise-Ablation/blob/main/results/issue1_root_ac_tcc_v7_actual_2026-10-10.json)).
- W4C independent complete S4 obligations (separate blocker) is a parallel prerequisite for W5.

### Exact acceptance (all mandatory)
1. Source-implemented upstream public S1/S2→candidate semantic admissibility determination with explicit true/false per candidate, no oracle/hardcoded ID, task-label or hidden judge mapping.
2. Provable genuine source-of-truth binding to frozen same-case S1/S2 SHA, authority and model/version/commit, with no test-answer access.
3. All-admissible selected set correctness on cases including COMPETING M003 and EQUIVALENT M009, plus held-out disjoint cases, and valid per-candidate machine-readable reasons.
4. Negative gates: forged authority proof, code change, candidate duplication, dataset contamination, scorer leakage, prompt re-tuning after seeing gold, and unbound source SHA all fail closed.
5. Produce a versioned successor qualification; never overwrite old Phase1 V1/V2 or relabel ECv4.4 singleton as generic S3. Do not mark original root AC-03/AC-05/AC-17 PASS until real A/B/C/D/E across all four layers actually execute.

**Current state: OPEN / IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED**, not covered by existing 14 native source tests. The fully autonomous TCC v7 stops with `W4_NATIVE_EXECUTED_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED` rather than fabricating acceptance.

issues.title: W5 P0: A–E Oracle nontarget layer changes bypass target-only causal gate
issues.body:
## Parent / scope
Blocks the **scientific causal qualification** of original Phase1 Issue #1 W5, downstream of native S3/S4 source qualification (#59/#60). Not an expansion of the frozen original 18-AC MVP. Keep frozen `tools/issue1_phase1_ae_gate_v1.py` and TCC v10 evidence immutable; implement a versioned successor with negative tests.

## Executed counterexample (2026-10-11 JST)
The actual pinned research checkout `/private/tmp/llmec-pinned-run-20261009` was used read-only, importing `setup_ae()`, `verify`, `h`, `LAYERS` from the existing v10 test and v1 gate. For arm `E_S1`, **S2** (a nontarget layer) was replaced with `{"additional_oracle_override": true}`; its `upstream` SHA chain was recomputed. The existing scorer returned **`ADDITIONAL_E_NON_TARGET_ACCEPTED True`** via `verify(raw,gold)["all_arm_and_hash_gates_passed"]`.

This establishes a *structural false-positive*: v1 checks prior-layer equality and target-layer equality against the Oracle, but does not observe/authenticate the implementations of **later nontarget layers**. A source-integrity SHA chain only checks internal consistency after mutation. An attacker or misconfigured runner can change S2/S3/S4 in `E_S1` and still present it as a one-layer Oracle intervention. The baseline E result can therefore be spuriously inflated. The existing output already declares `original_AC18_pass_automatically=False`, so this does **not** retroactively change current 2/18 or certify any actual scientific corruption.

## Mandatory corrective acceptance (P0 before W5; not a new root AC)
1. Create **versioned** raw/runner contract for A/B/C/D and E_S1..E_S4. For each layer, record executed engine code/source fingerprint, model/version/seed/parameters, authoritative exact upstream input hash, actual emitted output hash and runtime execution receipt. The Oracle must be the only changed engine in E at the target layer; later layers must genuinely use the pinned baseline implementation on newly propagated upstream outputs. Merely comparing outputs or accepting `implementation:"ORACLE_INTERVENTION"` is inadequate.
2. Strictly bind every receipt to actual executions by source-pinned replay / trusted instrumentation, not user-authored JSON or a recalculated hash alone. Independent Oracle/gold must not be accessible to the nontarget predictor. Missing/unverifiable receipts: **fail closed**, no causal qualification.
3. Add negative controls: E_S1 with additional S2 Oracle, E_S2 with additional S3 Oracle, E_S3 with additional S4 Oracle; forged runner/engine fields, mutated receipts, stale hashes, replay mismatch, duplicate/missing arms/cases and Oracle leakage. Each must fail; all clean matched arms replay deterministically.
4. Compare A/B and C/D with identical frozen S1/S2, and E with identical upstream to A **before** target intervention, use real raw model + native EC execution for all four layers, then compute the frozen original 0.20 gain unchanged.
5. Preserve historical v1 and v10 sealed outputs; never claim original root 18/18 or nondegradation solely from structural receipt validation. Link target-only receipt proof to original AC-07/16/17 and W5.

## Current state
**REPRODUCED / NOT FIXED / W5 CAUSAL CLAIM BLOCKED.** No GitHub Actions, no external-science certification from self-created fixtures.
